Can all those that participated in our winter season, please take a few minutes to fill in our survey on this years winter programme.

We really do appreciate you taking the time to fill this in, as it will help the Cross Country and Road Committee with their planning for 2027!

The link is here https://forms.cloud.microsoft/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=ZgaZvm_VaUC1OGDtOJJgnyMP-1hz6qZMua27-nIBZvpUQklEWjA2OEtGMEtYTFVGQlQ4WTcxWkdMSC4u

The survey will close on end of day 16th October.

text: Athletics Canterbury have a opportunities for children to experience athletics at the Ngā Puna Wai track in a non-competitive environment.

sharedPost.text:
Athletics for Everyone! 

All kids aged 7–14 are welcome at Ngā Puna Wai Athletics Track. No experience required!

📅 Starts Sunday 25 October
⏰ 2:00–3:00pm
📍 Ngā Puna Wai Athletics Track
💰 $5 per session or $25 for 6 sessions

The programme runs through Term 4 and continues into Term 1.
